headline: Alanyaspor lost 0-3 but stay clear favourites at home
summary: Alanyaspor lost 0-3 at Fenerbahçe on Saturday, but the market treats that as a trip to a stronger side rather than a collapse. On Friday they host Kocaelispor, who sit 8th on 12 points — level with them — and arrive without two regular defenders, both muscle injuries. Across 10 bookmakers, with the margin removed, Alanyaspor are 47.5% favourites. Their defending explains why the handicap rates them only about half a goal the stronger side: they have conceded 1.94 expected goals per game, more than they create. Over 2.25 goals is just 46.5%, so the market leans under.
read: Alanyaspor are clear home favourites at 47.5% despite a 0-3 defeat at Fenerbahçe, because Kocaelispor arrive with two regular defenders out and only a slim chance of their own at 22.6%. The market expects a tight, low-scoring game: the goals line sits at 2.25 with the home side rated only about half a goal better on the handicap.

facts.fact: Alanyaspor are clear favourites at 47.5% to win, more than double Kocaelispor's 22.6%.
facts.meaning: The market expects the home side to take the points, but the draw at 29.8% is far from written off.

facts.fact: Alanyaspor lost 0-3 at Fenerbahçe on 17 October, their first defeat in five league games.
facts.meaning: They had drawn two and won two before that trip, so this is a good run interrupted rather than a slump.

facts.fact: Kocaelispor are without defender M. Haidara (6 appearances, 474 minutes) and fellow defender T. Zoukrou (5 appearances, 416 minutes), both muscle injuries.
facts.meaning: Two of their most-used defenders miss a trip to a home side that will be looking for a response.

facts.fact: Kocaelispor lost 1-2 at home to Göztepe on 18 October despite out-creating them 1.61 xG to 0.83.
facts.meaning: They are still making chances — the results, not the performances, are the problem right now.

facts.fact: Alanyaspor have conceded more chance quality than they have created over their last five: 1.94 xG against per game to 1.38 for.
facts.meaning: Their points have come with a negative chance balance — they are not controlling games at home either.

facts.fact: The goals line sits at 2.25 with over priced at 46.5%.
facts.meaning: The market leans under — a single-goal game is the central picture, not a shootout.

facts.fact: Alanyaspor beat Kocaelispor 5-0 in the most recent meeting in Alanya, in March.
facts.meaning: A repeat is a stretch, but it is the reference point for how this fixture has gone at this ground.

facts.fact: The sides are level on 12 points from 8 games, Kocaelispor 8th and Alanyaspor 9th.
facts.meaning: Nothing separates them in the table, yet the home side is priced at more than double the visitors' chance.

sources.fact: Kocaelispor coach Selçuk İnan said he expects Alanyaspor to line up with a three-man defence.
Selçuk İnan said defender Matej Maglica could start in the first XI if he is not deemed a risk.
Selçuk İnan said injuries have become a cliché for Kocaelispor this season ahead of the Alanyaspor match.
Selçuk İnan gave an update on the fitness of three players before the Alanyaspor game, according to Sporx.
Kocaelispor defender Matej Maglica said the team wants to return from Alanyaspor with a win and believes in the coach's plans.
Kocaelispor are preparing for the match with the message "Parola 3 Puan" (password three points), according to Özgün Kocaeli.
Sergen Yalçın, now appointed Türkiye national team coach, previously managed Alanyaspor during his managerial career, Türkiye Today reports.
Alanyaspor lost 3-0 at Fenerbahçe in the Süper Lig, with Romelu Lukaku scoring his first Süper Lig goal, according to beIN SPORTS' match summary.
